==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I learned how to become a liquid and used that power to explore the sewers. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (I can use my Solvo spell on myself to become a liquid and then use Fingo to reconstitute myself as a solid. I used this spell combo to move through a small sewer grate in the village.)
There I discovered superpowered mutant elves and elves in white hazmat suits fighting over nuclear rods. (The mutant elves dressed in different colored armor suits made of dragon scales. So far I have met two male mutants, Mutant Blue and Mutant Purple. Both had short blonde hair. Mutant Purple wears blue glasses and has a full beard. Mutant Blue doesn't wear glasses and has a mustache.) (The elves in the hazmat suits were immediately hostile, while the mutant elves were immediately friendly.)
I joined forces with the mutants to defend the rods, which are the source of their mutant powers.
